messages:
Maria D.: Heads up — thinking through a developer-facing 'change walkthrough' + export controls for audit. Goal: let engineers see who changed what and when, step through a timeline, and optionally export a compact summary or the full event stream for investigations. Thoughts?

AJ: +1. Two quick asks: 1) export formats: ndjson for full fidelity, csv for quick summaries. 2) fields we should include by default: actor_id, actor_email, role, action, resource, diff_summary, policy_version, timestamp, region, request_id. Full diffs should be optional.

Samir: Agree on formats. Important: default exports must redact PII. "full_payload" exports should require an elevated permission and an audit trail (who requested + approver). Also retention-aware — can't export events beyond retention window unless legal hold.

Carla: Also legal/compliance: we need KMS logging for any export with unredacted data and a way to apply legal holds. Huge exports should be streamed to object storage and gated by egress policy (no direct download for >100k events).

Jorge: API sketch idea:

POST /v1/audit/exports
Body: {
  "filter": "actor.email:team@redwood.com AND timestamp:>2024-01-01",
  "format": "ndjson|csv|parquet",
  "fields": ["summary","diff_full"],
  "redaction_level": "default|pii|none",
  "delivery": {"type":"presigned|stream","bucket":"s3://..."}
}

Example curl: 
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/audit/exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"filter":"resource.type:route","format":"ndjson","delivery":{"type":"presigned"}}'

Evan: From console UX side: prefer a two-pane "walkthrough" modal — left is timeline, right is selected event detail + inline diff viewer (collapsed by default). Add an "Export" button in the top-right that opens export modal with presets (last 24h, last 7d, custom). Show estimated event count, size, and estimated cost before confirm. For PII exports, require an approver step and show approver history.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: audit-export-api v1 rolled out to staging :rocket:

Maria D.: Nice. Next steps: Jorge to draft API shape (PR), Evan do quick Figma mock, Samir/Carla to write security + redaction checklist. Who owns the first PR?

AJ: I'll take the API PR and include basic schema + pagination. Will ping Samir for RBAC checks. :thumbsup:

Samir: I'll prepare the redaction policy list (sensitive_keys.md) and examples for redaction configs.

Evan: I'll drop a Figma link in this thread once mock is ready.

Carla: I'll loop in compliance/legal for sign-off — cc: @legal-team. :eyes:

Maria D.: Great — flagging this for the next eng sync. If anyone hits blockers, drop notes here and we can triage.
